# `ext::http2_frame` — declaration reference

Generated source inventory. Linked guides own runtime and semantic contracts; a listed declaration does not establish executable behavior.

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../extended/ext/http2_frame.lani#L5)

Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

HTTP/2 frame codec (RFC 9113 sections 4 and 6): constants for frame types, flags, error codes and SETTINGS; next() parses one frame with the size, stream-zero, fixed-length and padding rules as connection or stream errors; per-type payload readers (DATA without padding, HEADERS priority and self-dependency, PUSH_PROMISE, RST_STREAM, PING, GOAWAY, WINDOW_UPDATE, SETTINGS with value checks) and writers that split header blocks into HEADERS + CONTINUATION and data into frames of the peer's maximum size. Exercised through the ext::http2 engine oracles.
